caption: The open house question that got me 3 buyer consults in one Sunday. Comment SCRIPT and I'll DM it to you.
transcript: I am a first-year agent and open houses scared me. So I stopped asking people if they had an agent. Instead I asked: what is the one thing this house got right that your current place does not? People talk for five minutes. Three of them booked a buyer consult with me that afternoon. Comment SCRIPT and I will send you the whole thing.
